exact/short_poem.text:
The salt wind howls against the stone,
A lonely sentinel, alone.
He climbs the spiral, step by step,
To keep the ancient promise kept.
The wick is trimmed, the glass is clear,
He banishes the creeping fear.
Below, the waves crash white and loud,
Upon the rocks, both hard and proud.
He watches ships sail safe and true,
Through the dark and endless blue.
The light turns slow, a golden eye,
Watching the world go by.
